_comment: What is inside the chests, and the one thing that is not. Every look here is a LOOK and nothing else: a duel is rock, paper, scissors, so the animal you picked is already a costume (decision-log row 53), and a reward that changed a fight would undo the one promise the duel makes. Numbers here are balance and belong in data/, not in code — move `wins` and nobody has to touch src/wins.js.
_kinds: A `tint` rotates the hue of every pixel of the creature's own sprite, so it costs no new art and works on all six animals. An `overlay` paints a short list of rectangles ON TOP, in art pixels, positioned relative to that creature's `face` anchor in data/monsters.json — [dx, dy, width, height, colour], where dx and dy are counted from the middle of its eyes. That is why the anchor exists: the six animals face different ways, and a fixed rectangle would put sunglasses on an elbow.
_earned: A look with a number in `wins` comes out of a chest at that many duels won. One with `wins: null` cannot: it is given for something else, and `from` says what. There is exactly one of those, and it is Aniki.
